findings.desc: packages/main/tests/b90d6-init-dispatch-guidance.test.mjs:189 WHY CHK-005 requires focused tests/smokes for session_brief, story_create/global help, and INIT_CHECK failure guidance, but the only executable init_preflight assertion in packages/main/tests/*.mjs is the INIT_CHECK guard-failure helper in this file. The recorded CHK-005 evidence at .lattice/story/actives/B-90d6/checklist.json:399 marks this test as covering those surfaces, yet it never drives session_brief, next, story_create, or lattice --help output; regressions in the high-traffic INIT guidance surfaces would pass this suite.

docs/CLI.md:329-331 says automatic milestone-status append is skipped when the target story has no milestone-ledger.json, but packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:903-904 falls back to an always-shown checklist-derived ledger and packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs:322-327 asserts missing-ledger story mutations must still show that checklist-derived status view. This docs drift contradicts CHK-008 forced status display behavior and can train agents to expect no status output for ledgerless stories; update the docs to distinguish real milestone_status tables from checklist-derived status output without implying a ledger mutation or gate pass.
